name: v0.3.25 — Connections: retailer setup hub (web + mobile)
releaseNotes:
• New /connections screen on web + mobile. Lists 12 supported retailers (Walmart · Target · Costco · Sam's Club · Amazon · Instacart · Safeway · Trader Joe's · Whole Foods · Kroger · Best Buy · Home Depot) with step-by-step setup instructions to forward each retailer's receipt emails to your GetGuac alias.
• Tap any retailer → bottom sheet with numbered setup steps + your alias to copy. Mark as 'active' when configured. Status persists per-user via the new user_connections table (migration_063).
• Receipts that arrive from a retailer's email domain will eventually auto-promote that connection from 'active' → 'verified' (with receipts-seen count). Verification trigger comes in a follow-up; today the user marks setup themselves.
• Same retailer catalog drives both platforms — add a new retailer once in lib/retailers.js + lib/data/retailers.dart and it shows everywhere.
